statement: For an ambient-null plane centralizer loop, every open generated-group orbit with at least three distinct actual lifted boundary-quotient fiber partitions has a closed actual lifted loop-generated group: R², the positive affine line group, or the scalar homothety group R² semidirect R. These groups have globally invertible exponentials. The exact Polish source-lift quotient gives a jointly continuous action on the whole orbit closure and a based fractional-power contraction with continuous inverse. All actual boundary quotient equations are retained; the contractions agree on intersections and with C37 on X2, and are transported by every original operator. They paste on every finite union of these closures and X2.
depends_on: C29 ambient-null circle winding; C36 exact closure quotient and Lie exponential formulas; C37 exact metabelian line/circle action images; C42-C45 actual boundary quotients and covering maps; C47 full three-web local compactness; compact-word-track Baire argument; Yamabe 1950 analytic-subgroup theorem; explicit Lie-algebra and transitive-subgroup classification
manuscript_passages: Section 23, folios 140-141, scans 279-281; Part C(b) infinite-operator request; actual simultaneous boundary-quotient and frontier-extension obligations
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The actual based lifted group is proved transitive by compact word tracks and countably many commuting deck translates. Yamabe is used only for the analytic subgroup structure; an explicit transitive-subgroup classification proves closedness and the induced topology before any quotient action on the closure is formed.
notes: The three real-quotient stabilizer Lie algebras force scalar isotropy on the two-dimensional tangent quotient. Zero scalar would make isotropy a normal action kernel; nonzero scalar forces an abelian translation plane and the homothety Lie algebra. The connected isotropy and contractible source quotient give the simply connected group and exact standard homogeneous action. Any proper two-dimensional analytic subgroup with a nonzero dilation projection preserves an affine line; hence the actual transitive generated group is either all homotheties or translations. The source lift and each circle target lift return to identity using the ambient-null winding comparison and pair injectivity. The closed Polish group of compatible (global element, actual lifted element) pairs projects openly and onto the actual Lie group, and its kernel fixes the whole orbit closure. Common boundary images have their actual intrinsic Lie topology, so based-cover exponential naturality proves all compatibility equations. The theorem proves finite-union frontier extension, including compatibility with X2, but leaves infinite accumulation of the new homothety cases and extension through the remaining one/two-foliation regions explicit.
